messages:
lena-cs: Hey team, acme-prod reported 403s for embeddings and rerank after we enabled their IdP JIT provisioning yesterday. Chat/generate still works. trace_id=tr_abc123. Repro below.

lena-cs: Repro curl -> embeddings API: 
```
curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer <svc-token>\" \\n  -d '{\"input\": \"foo\"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings 

HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{\"error\":\"insufficient_entitlements\",\"missing\":[\"embeddings\",\"rerank\"]}
```

lena-cs: Also tried rerank endpoint, same 403. Customer gave an id token sample from their IdP (redacted):
```
# decoded id token payload (redacted)
{
  \"sub\": \"svc_acme_42\",
  \"email\": \"svc@acme.com\",
  \"scopes\": \"embeddings generate\",  # space-delimited string from IdP
  \"entitlements\": \"embeddings\"
}
```

omar-infra: thanks, looking. do we have provisioning logs for that tenant?

lena-cs: yes, attaching provisioner log snippet: 
```
INFO Provisioner: creating service token for tenant=acme-prod sub=svc_acme_42
parsed_scopes=[\"embeddings\"]  <-- only one scope parsed
stored_entitlements=[\"embeddings\"]
```

kai-identity: pinging -- this looks like an IdP format mismatch. our parser expects scopes as an array or comma-separated list; IdP sent a space-delimited single string so our shell-split normalized to first token in one path.

kai-identity: quick timeline: IdP JIT triggered -> ssoproxy forwarded claim 'scopes' as string -> provisioning split logic used `strings.Split(scopes, ",")` -> result = [\"embeddings generate\"] (no comma) -> downstream sanitizer then took first element -> created token with only \"embeddings\" entitlement.

simon-eng: that would explain chat/generate working (generate present in the string, but lost during split path?) and why rerank is missing (we never saw a rerank entitlement). can you confirm whether rerank should be requested by the customer app?

lena-cs: customer says they call rerank and embeddings directly. they expected JIT to grant both. they never got rerank.

mara-support: customer is blocked in production, marked P0. they've accepted a temporary API key until we fix. recording workaround: create explicit API key with entitlements [\"generate\",\"embeddings\",\"rerank\"] and disable JIT for that tenant.

kai-identity: I will open a PR in the provisioner to: normalize whitespace, accept space/comma/array, and add unit tests for the ssoproxy claim shapes. quick patch should be small.

simon-eng: thanks. assign to eng-identity + eng-provisioner. also we should add a migration job to scan recently provisioned service tokens and reconcile entitlements for tenants that used JIT in the last 24h.

omar-infra: logging note: ssoproxy currently passes raw claim as string. we can add a defensive normalization layer in ssoproxy to canonicalize scopes into JSON array before hitting provisioner. will follow up with a PR.

lena-cs: customer confirmed temporary key works and they're back online. they want ETA on permanent fix.

kai-identity: planning: quick fix to provisioner today (1-2h), ssoproxy normalization tomorrow if we want belt-and-suspenders. migration job to repair tokens -> scheduled for next maintenance window. I'll post PR links when ready.

deploy-bot: deploy pipeline report: CI for provisioner PR passed unit tests, integration job pending.

simon-eng: once the PR lands, we should do a small canary for a few tenants, then roll. mark as P1->P0 until confirmed for acme-prod. good catch everyone :thumbsup:

lena-cs: cc @mara-support - I updated customer with workaround + timeline. I'll close this thread when we confirm post-fix.

mara-support: noted, leaving open until migration completes and acme-prod verifies.
